title: Configure metered usage billing
summary: When a product charges based on measured consumption, credits or contract-specific usage commitments. A reviewed billing specification with reproducible meter-to-invoice tests and controlled production activation.
outcomes: A reviewed billing specification with reproducible meter-to-invoice tests and controlled production activation.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a product charges based on measured consumption, credits or contract-specific usage commitments.

parts.title: Specify the billable events and customer identity
parts.guidance: Define units, event timestamps, customer identifiers, aggregation windows and excluded activity. Describe duplicate, late and missing events so engineers and finance share one billing specification.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve pricing and contractual treatment
parts.guidance: The commercial owner and advisers approve rates, commitments, credit expiry treatment and dispute handling for applicable contracts. Resolve uncertain terms before accepting billable usage.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Prepare a reproducible usage test dataset
parts.guidance: Build fictional events for normal use, duplicates, late arrival, corrections and customer changes. Calculate expected quantities and charges independently from the provider output.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Configure approved meters and billing rules
parts.guidance: Authorized operators apply reviewed settings in a test environment using the provider currently supported integration. Preserve versioned event schemas and avoid creating real charges during configuration.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Configure approved meters and billing rules

parts.title: Verify quantities and customer-visible invoices
parts.guidance: Engineering and finance compare events, aggregations, credits and invoice previews to independent expectations. Block launch on unexplained differences or inability to trace a charge back to usage.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Authorize production billing and monitor exceptions
parts.guidance: The accountable owner approves production activation. Authorized operators enable the reviewed configuration, monitor missing events and reconcile invoices; refunds or corrective charges require scoped approval.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Authorize production billing and monitor exceptions

verify.how: A reviewed billing specification with reproducible meter-to-invoice tests and controlled production activation.
